rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a film, book, activity, or event that fails to hold your attention.

example.english: The film was uninteresting, and I fell asleep after watching it for half an hour.
example.traditional: 套戲好悶，我睇咗半個鐘就瞓着咗。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 hou2 mun6 ngo5 tai2 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 zau6 fan3 zoek6 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the thing is boring because it feels pointless, trivial, or lacking in substance.

example.english: These meetings are uninteresting; even after they are over, I don't know what use they are.
example.traditional: 呢啲會議好無聊，講完都唔知有咩用。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 wui6 ji5 hou2 mou4 liu4 gong2 jyun4 dou1 m4 zi1 jau5 me1 jung6
